about.headline: Who is Yashita Namdeo?
about.body: Yashita Namdeo is a Senior Software Engineer at MeasureOne, where she has grown from Engineering Intern (2022) through Associate and Software Engineer into senior ownership of verification and data-access product modules. She leads delivery across 5+ projects, runs Scrum ceremonies, and pairs Angular/Node/SQL implementation with accessibility (WCAG) and test discipline (Karma, Jasmine, Mocha, Chai). CSE graduate of SVIIT / SVVV Indore (2018–2022), she also ships open source — her personal portfolio template has 460+ GitHub stars — and practices DSA on LeetCode (191+) and GeeksforGeeks.
